purpose: Prepares a personalised, brand-aligned follow-up email or WhatsApp draft from approved message templates and stores it for staff approval before any sending.

configurationFields.description: Must remain false; sending is done by send-approved-reminder or staff
Phrases the draft must never contain (results, guarantees)

permissionsRequired: Send enquiry text to the configured LLM provider (requires intake ai_data_consent=true)
Write drafts to the tenant's follow_up_drafts table

testCases.expectedOutcome: Draft created with status awaiting-approval; nothing sent

testCases.description: Draft contains a forbidden claim such as 'guaranteed selection'
testCases.expectedOutcome: Draft rejected and regenerated or falls back to the plain template

testCases.description: autoSend set to true in config
testCases.expectedOutcome: Workflow refuses to start and reports a configuration error

knownLimitations: Contract only: n8n blueprint JSON not yet built and exported (Phase B).
Drafts must be approved in the lead dashboard or by email reply.
rollbackApproach: Deactivate the workflow; staff use the static message templates manually.
